t: Hub framework symlink must point to teachings/ folder only — not full framework repo

content.signal: Hub framework symlink must point to teachings/ folder only — not the entire framework repo. Full-repo symlink creates data pollution risk and breaks the separation between framework internals and distributable teachings.
content.rationale: Architecture decision affecting all spokes and how the hub accesses framework content. Canonicalizes the teachings/ folder as the only public interface of the framework repo.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Architecture record: hub/framework symlink scope constraint.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: An instruction to change any current configuration.
